title: qBittorrent
descript: qBittorrent is a full-featured BitTorrent client with a clean web UI: add magnet links or .torrent files, queue and seed, set speed limits, search for torrents and use RSS. It runs as a non-root container on your NAS, keeps settings and resume data in the application data folder, and writes downloads into a folder you control - no desktop client needed.
release_note: 1. The WebUI now opens through the mapped port and behind a reverse proxy: the package switches off qBittorrent's Host-header validation before start-up, which used to answer 401 whenever the Host port was not 8080 and made the page look broken. 2. Privacy policy added (repository + website) and every third-party service the client can contact is disclosed. 3. Health check now fails on a 401/5xx instead of only checking that the port answers.
important: Requires DockerEngine. First start prints a temporary admin password in the log (docker logs qbittorrentdocker) - log in as admin and change it. Downloads: DockerAppData/qbittorrentdocker/downloads, settings: .../config. Only the WebUI port is published; the BT port (6881) is not, so incoming peers are limited and speeds may be lower. Plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it. Privacy policy: https://www.moechz.com/privacy.html

zh-cn.descript: qBittorrent 是一款功能完整的 BT 客户端，自带清爽的网页界面：添加磁力链接或 .torrent、排队与做种、限速、搜索种子、RSS 订阅都可以在浏览器里完成。它以非 root 容器运行在 NAS 上，设置与续传数据保存在应用数据目录，下载文件放在你指定的目录，不需要装桌面客户端。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine。首次启动会在日志里打印临时管理员密码（docker logs qbittorrentdocker），用 admin 登录后请立即修改。下载文件在 DockerAppData/qbittorrentdocker/downloads，设置在 .../config。只发布 WebUI 端口，BT 端口（6881）未发布，入站连接较少、速度可能不如桌面客户端。界面为 HTTP，外网访问请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。隐私政策：https://www.moechz.com/privacy.html
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 修复 WebUI 打不开：通过端口映射（8041→8080）或反向代理访问时，qBittorrent 的 Host 头校验会一律返回 401，页面与静态资源都加载不出来；现在启动前关闭该校验（登录与 CSRF 防护不变）。2. 新增隐私政策（仓库 + 网站），并逐项披露客户端可能访问的第三方服务。3. 健康检查改为对 401/5xx 判失败。

zh-hk.descript: qBittorrent 是一款功能完整的 BT 客戶端，自帶清爽的網頁介面：新增磁力連結或 .torrent、排隊與做種、限速、搜尋種子、RSS 訂閱都可以在瀏覽器裡完成。它以非 root 容器運行在 NAS 上，設定與續傳資料保存在應用資料目錄，下載檔案放在你指定的目錄，不需要裝桌面客戶端。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine。首次啟動會在日誌裡印出臨時管理員密碼（docker logs qbittorrentdocker），用 admin 登入後請立即修改。下載檔案在 DockerAppData/qbittorrentdocker/downloads，設定在 .../config。只發佈 WebUI 端口，BT 端口（6881）未發佈，入站連線較少、速度可能不如桌面客戶端。介面為 HTTP，外網存取請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。隱私政策：https://www.moechz.com/privacy.html
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 修復 WebUI 打不開：透過端口映射（8041→8080）或反向代理存取時，qBittorrent 的 Host 標頭檢查會一律回傳 401，頁面與靜態資源都載入不出來；現在啟動前關閉該檢查（登入與 CSRF 防護不變）。2. 新增隱私政策（倉庫 + 網站），並逐項披露客戶端可能存取的第三方服務。3. 健康檢查改為對 401/5xx 判定失敗。

data_notes: `/config` (mounted from `DockerAppData/qbittorrentdocker/config`) keeps `qBittorrent/qBittorrent.conf` plus the resume data; `/downloads` (mounted from `.../downloads`) is where finished and in-progress torrents are written.
design_notes: **Runs unprivileged with the upstream entrypoint.** The LinuxServer.io image in this tag can run as uid 1000, so no wrapper is needed; the volumes are chowned by the installer.
**First-run password in the log.** No password is baked into the package: qBittorrent generates a temporary one and the user changes it in the WebUI.
**One published port.** Only the WebUI (8080) is exposed; the BT listen port stays inside the container, which is the trade-off for the store's single-port rule.
limitations: - The WebUI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
- The BitTorrent listen port (6881) is not published, so incoming peers cannot connect and speeds may be lower than a desktop client.
- The downloads folder is not visible in TOS File Manager; manage files over SMB/SSH or add the path to a backup task.
